Glossary

Speak the language.

Endpoint

One provider serving one model at one declared precision on OpenRouter.

Declared quantization

The precision the provider lists: bf16 or fp16 is full precision; fp8, fp4 and int4 are smaller and cheaper to run.

Reference

The answer the full-precision endpoints give. What every endpoint is graded against.

Agreement

The share of prompts where an endpoint gives the reference answer.

Quality-adjusted price

Blended price divided by agreement. What a correct answer costs.

Drift

An endpoint whose answers move over the period, measured against its own first nights.
